criteria.C1: lower 95% block-bootstrap CI bound of walking-vs-empty AUC >= 0.80 in protocol (b) AND in every applicable train session of protocol (c)
criteria.C2: fan false-positive rate not above empty false-positive rate (pooled, at both alpha = 1% and 5%) in protocols (b) and (c)
criteria.C3: no held-out empty recording flagged occupied in more than 5% of windows at the alpha = 1% threshold, in protocols (b) and (c)
criteria.verdict_rule: a candidate (feature, rule) meets the criteria only if C1, C2 and C3 all hold; if none does, the report says so and stops
